name: backfill-league-stats
description: Standalone Admin SDK script — the Stats Rules audit (Season 1) League-only leaderboard stats backfill. Reads every currently-confirmed League match in the chalkie-app Firebase project (read-only), computes each player's leagueLegsWon/leagueLegsPlayed/leagueGamesWon/leagueGamesPlayed the same way the live Cloud Function aggregation does, and (only with --apply) writes JUST those four fields to playerSeasonStats. Never touches matches, fixtures, legsWon, or any other field. See README.md before running anything.
